examName: Assistant Professor (Microbiology) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-A (Collegiate Branch) Higher and Technical Education Department
examNameMr: सहायक प्राध्यापक (सूक्ष्मजीवशास्त्र) महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-अ (संस्थेची शाखा) उच्च आणि तंत्रशिक्षण विभाग
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: History and scope of microbiology
Principles and methods of taxonomy, classification and taxonomy of microorganisms
Microscopy and Staining Techniques: Types of microscopy (light, electron, fluorescence), Basic staining techniques: simple, differential (Gram, acid-fast)
Control of Microbial Growth: Physical methods: heat, filtration, radiation; Chemical control: disinfectants, antiseptics, and antibiotics
Structure and function of microbial cells (bacteria, archaea, fungi, viruses, algae, and protozoa)
Growth and reproduction of microbes, including microbial growth kinetics

units.unitTitleMr: सूक्ष्मजीव जैव रसायन, शरीरविज्ञान आणि चयापचय
topics: Principles of biophysical chemistry (pH, buffer, reaction kinetics, thermodynamics and colligative properties)
Structure and function of biomolecules in microbes
Conformation and stability of proteins and nucleic acids
Overview of microbial metabolism: catabolic and anabolic pathways
Metabolic pathways and energy production in microbial cells, electron transport chain and ATP synthesis
Lipid, nucleic acid, amino acid and protein metabolism in microbes
Aerobic and anaerobic respiration, fermentation, and phototrophy
Structure and function of enzymes, mechanism of enzyme action and enzyme kinetics, regulation of enzyme activity
Biochemical adaptations of extremophiles
Secondary metabolites and bioactive compounds
Structural biology tools (e.g., X-ray crystallography, NMR, cryo-EM) in studying microbial proteins
Bioanalytical methods: Spectroscopic, Chromatographic and Electrophoretic

units.unitTitle: Evolution, Microbial Genetics and Molecular Biology
units.unitTitleMr: उत्क्रांती, सूक्ष्मजीव अनुवंशशास्त्र आणि रेणवीय जीवशास्त्र
topics: Mendelian principles, concept of gene and extension of Mendelian principles, Lamarck, Darwin- concepts of variation, adaptation, struggle, fitness and natural selection

Origin of cells and unicellular evolution: origin of basic biological molecules, abiotic synthesis of organic monomers and polymers, concept of Oparin and Haldane, experiment of Miller, evolution of prokaryotes, origin of eukaryotic cells
Salient features of genetic code, structure, replication, and function of DNA and RNA
Molecular evolution: molecular divergence and molecular clocks
Gene mapping methods
Gene expression, operon concept and regulation in prokaryotes and eukaryotes
RNA synthesis and processing
Protein synthesis and processing
Genetic recombination and implications for microbial evolution; horizontal gene transfer: transformation, transduction, and conjugation; Plasmids, transposons
Extra chromosomal inheritance
Mutations and repair mechanisms
Overview of cancer genetics, immunogenetics and pharmacogenomics
Basic and advanced genetic engineering techniques, Microbial genomics and proteomics
Blood and circulation
Components and functions of the immune system: innate and adaptive immunity
Antigens: Determinants of antigenicity, types of antigens, MHC
Antibodies: structure, types, classes with functions
Antigen-antibody reactions and immune responses to infections
Hypersensitivity, autoimmunity and autoimmune diseases
Mechanisms of microbial pathogenicity: an overview of virulence factors, persistent infections, bacterial toxins, enzymes, and surface structures in pathogenesis
Host-microbe interactions: commensalism, mutualism, parasitism
Mechanisms of microbial evasion of host defences and immune evasion

Histochemical and immune techniques: detection of molecules using ELISA, RIA, Western Blot, immunoprecipitation, flowcytometry and immunofluorescence microscopy, detection of molecules in living cells, in situ hybridization (FISH & GISH)
Microbial pathogens: bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic diseases
Emerging infectious diseases and zoonoses
Antimicrobial agents, mechanisms of antibiotic actions and resistance, and current strategies in antibiotic discovery and development
Vaccines, Toxoids, immune sera, immunization schedule
Epidemiology, prevention, and control of infectious diseases
The Environment: Physical environment, biotic environment, biotic and abiotic interactions
Microbial ecology: interactions and roles in ecosystems, Biofilms
Adaptive evolution and genome plasticity in microbes
Biogeochemical cycles: carbon, nitrogen, sulphur, and phosphorus
Microbial interactions with plants: the rhizosphere and plant growth promotion
Microbial communities in soil, water, and extreme environments
Bioremediation and microbial applications in environmental clean-up

units.unitTitleMr: औद्योगिक, औषध निर्माण आणि अन्न सूक्ष्मजीवशास्त्र
topics: Microbial fermentation processes and applications
Production of bio-based products: enzymes, antibiotics, biofuels, organic acids
Microbial spoilage of food and food preservation techniques, Pasteurisation and other heat treatments, foodborne pathogens and foodborne illnesses
Methods for detecting and quantifying microorganisms in food and milk
Principles of Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) in the food and dairy industry, Overview of GMP for the food industry
Probiotics, prebiotics, functional foods and their role in health
Overview of the drug life cycle: Stages of drug development, Clinical Research
Quality control, assurance and safety regulations in the food and pharmaceutical industries
Structure and classification of viruses
Replication strategies of DNA and RNA viruses
Viral pathogenesis and mechanisms of disease production
Antiviral strategies and vaccine development
Emerging viral pathogens and zoonotic viruses
Techniques in recombinant DNA technology: cloning, gene editing, and expression
Applications of biotechnology in medicine, agriculture, and industry
Microbial Bio-mining, biofertilizers, biopesticides
Microbial biopolymers and bioplastics
Principles of synthetic biology and metabolic engineering

units.unitTitle: Bioinformatics and Data Analysis in Microbiology
topics: Introduction to bioinformatics databases and sequence alignment
Phylogenetic analysis and microbial classification
Omics technologies: genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics
Analysis of microbial communities using metagenomics
Basic statistical and computational tools for microbiological data analysis

units.unitTitle: Emerging Topics and Trends in Microbiology
topics: Current advances in microbiome research and human health
Molecular approaches to diagnosis and strain identification
CRISPR and gene editing technologies in microbiology
Bioterrorism and high-risk pathogens
Bioethics of microbial research, biosafety levels, and regulations
Systems biology and applications in understanding microbial networks
Environmental microbiology and implications for climate change
